Method: Opt-in fixed-ROI motion feed on the mounted live table; dashboard metrics polled once per second; no images saved.
Scope: Three valid runs at 15, 30 and 60 Hz requests. Initial 15 Hz attempt stopped early and was excluded after the collector was fixed to reject a populated stop reason.
PercentileNote: P50/P95 are calculated over one-second metric snapshots, not per-frame samples. ProcessedSourceCadenceHz is the feed rolling source-PTS cadence (up to ten seconds, reset on source gaps).
ResourceNote: CPU, memory, thermal state, battery, interruption/recovery, tracking accuracy and ball identity were not measured.
